title: Conditional VAEs generate designer recombinases active on new target sites
summary: RecGen trained conditional variational autoencoders on >1 million Cre-like recombinase sequences evolved for 89 targets, and experimental validation showed predicted recombinases with activity on novel target sites. Abstract-level review only; success rate not read.

evidence.tested: Experimental activity assays on novel target sites.
evidence.unknown: Hit rate, specificity and therapeutic use not assessed here.
evidence.ai_role: Generative model proposed recombinase sequences for unseen targets.
